---
title: "Talk title"
subtitle: "Subtitle / conference name"
author:
  - name: "Firstname Lastname"
    affiliation: "Institution / Institute"
date: today
date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
lang: en

bibliography: ../bibtex/references.bib
csl: ../bibtex/csl/chicago-author-date.csl

format:
  revealjs:
    theme: default
    slide-number: true
    show-slide-number: all
    progress: true
    hash-type: number
    center: false
    transition: fade
    width: 1920
    height: 1080
    margin: 0.1
    lang: en
    footer: "Lastname — Short title — Conference 2026"
    logo: ""  # path to logo, e.g. images/logo.png
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-background-color: "#2d3436"
  pptx:
    slide-level: 2
    lang: en
  beamer:
    # Distinct output name: beamer and pdf both produce a PDF. `make all`
    # renders them separately and collects both into _output/, so they must
    # not share the name talk.pdf or one would overwrite the other.
    # Slides = 16:9 Beamer deck.
    output-file: "talk-slides.pdf"
    theme: metropolis
    fontsize: 11pt
    aspectratio: 169
    lang: en
    mainfont: "Gentium Plus"      # transliteration + polytonic Greek
    sansfont: "Noto Sans"         # headings: broad diacritic coverage incl. ʾ / ʿ
  pdf:
    # Distinct output name (see beamer above). Handout = A4 article layout
    # with all content, for reading rather than projection.
    output-file: "talk-handout.pdf"
    documentclass: scrartcl
    papersize: a4
    fontsize: 11pt
    mainfont: "Gentium Plus"      # transliteration + polytonic Greek
    number-sections: true
    toc: true
    lang: en

crossref:
  fig-prefix: "Fig."
  tbl-prefix: "Tab."
---
